title: That whine when you turn? Probably not your tires.
motionLens: documentary/macro-realistic (confirm exact lens + lens.avoid in the live Studio wizard)

generation.label: hook
generation.narration: That whine that gets louder in turns? It's not your tires.
generation.prompt: Close-up on the underside of a car's rear differential housing, sunlight catching a faint sheen on the metal casing, subtle engine-idle vibration visible in the frame; shallow depth of field, parking-lot pavement blurred in the background.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: the housing sharply lit and centered, strongest possible first frame, unbranded, wordless

generation.label: symptom
generation.narration: A moaning or whining noise that changes pitch as you turn, especially at low speed in a parking lot.
generation.prompt: Bird's-eye drone-style shot of a car slowly tracing a tight, complete circle in an empty parking lot, the inside tire's contact patch visibly scrubbing sideways against the pavement through the turn.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: continue conceptually from beat 1's vehicle, now in motion

generation.label: explanation
generation.narration: That points to your differential — the gears that let your wheels spin at different speeds in a turn.
generation.prompt: Object-only technical cutaway of an open differential gear case, the ring gear and pinion gear meshing while two spider gears inside rotate at different speeds as if the vehicle were turning; clean diagrammatic lighting, slow orbiting camera move; no text or labels rendered in-scene.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts, on-screen text, logos, watermarks
generation.openingFrame: establish the cutaway clearly at a glance

generation.label: consequence_proof
generation.narration: Low or worn-out gear oil lets those gears grind, and the whine usually gets louder over time, not better.
generation.prompt: Close-up comparison: two shallow dishes side by side under even studio light — one holding clean amber gear oil, the other holding dark, metal-fleck-flecked gear oil — camera does a slow rack-focus between them, no hands present.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: both dishes clearly readable at a glance, contrast established immediately

generation.label: safe_action
generation.narration: One clue is not a diagnosis — worth having the differential fluid checked before it turns into a bigger repair.
generation.prompt: A shop inspection light on a stand sweeps its beam across a differential housing's fill-plug bolt, the bolt's threads and a faint oil weep line clearly visible under the light — no hands present, the light beam itself is the only motion besides a slow rack-focus.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: fill-plug bolt clearly readable, light beam entering frame

generation.label: branded_cta
generation.narration: Stop by and we'll take a look — Nick's Tire and Auto, on Euclid Avenue.
generation.prompt: Exterior establishing shot of Nick's Tire & Auto's shop bay, tire stack in foreground, late-afternoon light, logo signage visible and legible; camera holds steady for a clean end-card composite.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: shop bay clearly readable, settles for a seamless hold into the freeze
